records.hint: Reminders are sent daily as employees approach a rule's milestone; a to-do is created here.
records.checkDone: Check complete: {{created}} created, {{hrNotified}} HR items notified

rules.hint: Define which seniority milestones trigger reminders. Each day the system checks active employees' hire dates and reminds N days before the eligible date.
rules.name: Benefit name
rules.scheduleHint: E.g. Retention bonus: 3 years, no repeat; Travel subsidy: 1 year, repeat every 1 year.
rules.deleteHint: Rule "{{name}}" will be deleted. Rules with existing records cannot be deleted; deactivate them instead.

holiday.recordsHint: One record per rule per year, company-wide. HR is notified N days before with headcount and estimated total.
holiday.rulesHint: Benefits with a different date each year (New Year red envelope, Dragon Boat, Mid-Autumn), same amount for everyone
holiday.noRecords: No yearly records yet. Calendar-based rules are created automatically when the date enters the reminder window; manual rules need this year's date added.
holiday.keywordHint: Matches holiday names in the holiday calendar, so the year's calendar must be imported first. If several days match (e.g. a make-up day), the earliest is used.
holiday.manualHint: For rules like the New Year red envelope, click "Add Yearly Date" under Yearly Payout Records and enter this year's date.
holiday.deleteRecordHint: The {{year}} record for "{{name}}" will be deleted.
